SELECT r.id AS review_id, p.nickname AS username, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.author_id AS authorId,
pip.id AS profile_img_id, pip.saved_file_name AS profile_img_name, pip.size AS profile_img_size, pip.path AS profile_img_path, pip.content_type AS profile_img_content_type,
rip.id AS review_img_id, rip.saved_file_name AS review_img_name, rip.size AS review_img_size, rip.path AS review_img_path, rip.content_type AS review_img_content_type
FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.author_id = u.id JOIN profile p ON u.id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN profile_image_property pip ON p.id = pip.profile_id
LEFT JOIN review_image_property rip ON r.id = rip.review_id
WHERE r.attraction_id = #{attractionNo} ORDER BY r.created_at ${sort != null and sort.name() == 'DESC' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'}
LIMIT #{pageRequest.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageRequest.offset};

SELECT r.id AS review_id, p.nickname AS username, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.author_id AS authorId, r.attraction_id AS attractionNo, a.title AS attractionName,
pip.id AS profile_img_id, pip.saved_file_name AS profile_img_name, pip.size AS profile_img_size, pip.path AS profile_img_path, pip.content_type AS profile_img_content_type,
rip.id AS review_img_id, rip.saved_file_name AS review_img_name, rip.size AS review_img_size, rip.path AS review_img_path, rip.content_type AS review_img_content_type
FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.author_id = u.id JOIN profile p ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON a.no = r.attraction_id
LEFT JOIN profile_image_property pip ON p.id = pip.profile_id
LEFT JOIN review_image_property rip ON r.id = rip.review_id
WHERE r.author_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at ${sort != null and sort.name() == 'DESC' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'}
LIMIT #{pageRequest.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageRequest.offset};

SELECT r.id AS review_id, p.nickname AS username, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.author_id AS authorId,
